title: Seagrove Beach “Southern Chateau” 71 Chivas Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Steps from the beach with a private beach boardwalk- Complimentary beach set up each morning includes 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella (Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 2026)- Private heated saltwater pool *Pool heating is available Oct 1-May 1 for $65 per day*- Complimentary Peloton Bike- an Alaya exclusive amenity- Game room - 9 adult bikes- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - Elevator- 3-Car garage- 2-Story carriage house- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: A testament to seaside splendor, Southern Chateau sits along the Emerald Coast, steps from the Gulf’s sugar-soft sand and turquoise water. The lavish Main House and Carriage House boast 8 bedrooms, 8 full bathrooms, and 3 half bathrooms, providing an unparalleled indoor and outdoor living experience for 22 guests in illustrious Seagrove Beach. Wake to dramatic views of the shimmering Gulf, lounge on the private beach frontage, or cool off in the saltwater pool of this Florida retreat, where every day is an expression of beachside decadence.Carefully crafted by renowned architect Geoff Chick, this 4-story and 7,911-square-foot home is steeped in coastal luxury and comfort. The ground floor hosts a cheerful guest bedroom with 2 full beds.On the second level, a coffered ceiling and gleaming wood floors frame the sweeping Gulf views in the main living areas. The chef’s kitchen is delightfully arranged for showcasing culinary prowess, with top-of-the-line appliances and a spacious island where 6 can socialize as dinner simmers. Partake in an elegant meal of vibrant flavors and vivacious conversation at the bleached wood table for 10. The living area’s arrangement of plush furnishings sits before floor-to-ceiling windows, offering mesmerizing views and the perfect spot to curl up with a book. Outside, drink in the majestic seascape beside the Gulf-front pool. A covered outdoor living room and kitchen cultivate a serene and sophisticated atmosphere. Savor a meal to the soundtrack of soothing waves and end the evening with a cocktail on the furnished wraparound deck overlooking the water. An outdoor shower around the corner makes trips to the private beachfront a breeze.Discover 4 well-appointed guest bedrooms and an opulent primary bedroom with a king bed, private balcony, and stunning Gulf views on the third floor.A lovely guest bedroom, along with a living room and game room, makes up the top level.For additional privacy, the connected 2-story Carriage House features its own comfortable living space, kitchen, and 2 guest bedrooms with 2 bathrooms.Paradise awaits at Southern Chateau in Seagrove Beach. Parking for 6 cars—plus 9 adult bikes and a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle—makes exploring easy. Follow the private boardwalk off the back deck to the beach. Book this unforgettable home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 22):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Two Full Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only SECOND FLOOR:- Living Area: Kitchen, Living Room, Dining Room, Butlers Pantry, Elevator, Half Bath, Laundry RoomTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate with Private Balcony and Gulf View- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only with Gulf Front Balcony- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only with Gulf Front Balcony- Guest Room: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-FOURTH FLOOR: Guest Bedroom: King Bedroom, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Living Area: Separate Living Room and Game RoomCARRIAGE HOUSE:FIRST FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Living Area: Living Room and Full Kitchen- Guest Bathroom: Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: 4 Twin Beds*Disclaimer: Construction next door to the home at Dunes of Seagrove.

The lavish Main House and Carriage House boast 8 bedrooms, 8 full bathrooms, and 3 half bathrooms, providing an unparalleled indoor and outdoor living experience for 22 guests in illustrious Seagrove Beach. Wake to dramatic views of the shimmering Gulf, lounge on the private beach frontage, or cool off in the saltwater pool of this Florida retreat, where every day is an expression of beachside decadence. Carefully crafted by renowned architect Geoff Chick, this 4-story and 7,911-square-foot home is steeped in coastal luxury and comfort. The ground floor hosts a cheerful guest bedroom with 2 full beds. On the second level, a coffered ceiling and gleaming wood floors frame the sweeping Gulf views in the main living areas. The chef’s kitchen is delightfully arranged for showcasing culinary prowess, with top-of-the-line appliances and a spacious island where 6 can socialize as dinner simmers. Partake in an elegant meal of vibrant flavors and vivacious conversation at the bleached wood table for 10. The living area’s arrangement of plush furnishings sits before floor-to-ceiling windows, offering mesmerizing views and the perfect spot to curl up with a book. Outside, drink in the majestic seascape beside the Gulf-front pool. A covered outdoor living room and kitchen cultivate a serene and sophisticated atmosphere. Savor a meal to the soundtrack of soothing waves and end the evening with a cocktail on the furnished wraparound deck overlooking the water. An outdoor shower around the corner makes trips to the private beachfront a breeze. Discover 4 well-appointed guest bedrooms and an opulent primary bedroom with a king bed, private balcony, and stunning Gulf views on the third floor. A lovely guest bedroom, along with a living room and game room, makes up the top level. For additional privacy, the connected 2-story Carriage House features its own comfortable living space, kitchen, and 2 guest bedrooms with 2 bathrooms. Paradise awaits at Southern Chateau in Seagrove Beach. Parking for 6 cars—plus 9 adult bikes and a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle—makes exploring easy. Follow the private boardwalk off the back deck to the beach. Book this unforgettable home today!
